recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的骨髓小粒周圍可見許多深藍色的大型巨核細胞，數量明顯多於一般，夾在脂肪空泡之間；配合 HIV 病人血小板低下，代表周邊破壞增加時骨髓巨核細胞代償性增生。
features: Low-power aspirate particle with interspersed large clear fat vacuoles
Increased numbers of megakaryocytes, appearing as large dark blue cells with abundant cytoplasm, several clustered together
Megakaryocytes vary in size; lobulation and dysplasia cannot be assessed at this magnification
Adequate background trilineage hematopoietic cells around the particle
No obvious clusters of atypical or non-hematopoietic cells
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular particles with interspersed fat vacuoles and adequate trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are conspicuously increased, appearing as numerous large dark-staining cells, some in small clusters. Megakaryocyte maturation and nuclear lobation require higher-power evaluation, and no atypical cell clusters are evident. In a patient with HIV and thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with megakaryocytic hyperplasia due to peripheral platelet destruction (immune thrombocytopenia).

ddx.vs: The marrow picture is identical, so the distinction rests on HIV serology and clinical context.
MPNs show large hyperlobated megakaryocytes with thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia, and harbor JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated or have separated lobes, often with dysplasia in other lineages.

ddx.dx: HIV-associated marrow involvement by lymphoma or infection
ddx.vs: These show granulomas, organisms or atypical lymphoid infiltrates rather than isolated megakaryocytic hyperplasia.
